args.Aisle: My husband Dave and our two teenagers all crowd into the kitchen whenever I'm
cooking, so the ceiling light gets a proper long innings. Get me the cheapest
total for the whole lot. I plate up under it and snap the dishes for the family
group chat. Here's my list for today: 3 ceiling lights with power consumption of
5000 and up, plus 3 milk teas in wintermelon flavour! Altogether I can spend
3850 pence, so every penny counts here. The cupboards are pale oak and the walls
are freshly painted, so how the lamp makes everything look is on my mind.
Everything on the list should be ready to ship out right away, no waiting around
on the boundary. Over to you, and ask me whatever helps you pick the right one!
After 2 messages from you, I stop replying. Each tool call counts as a step, and
14/15 them. | OrderWrapUp: Closes out the session; WayChoice=commit buys what
